cards.name: Summer Camps!
cards.description: Students form stringbands, work on music theory and ensemble skills, and perform for friends and families at the end of camp. Level Two also covers harmony, improvisation and arranging songs.
cards.review_notes: Confirm the year of the June 15–18 and July 13–16 dates: the supplied camp page and official search snippet do not print a year. Dates are provisionally recorded as 2026, not projected to 2027. Level One is for students in their first two years in JAM; Level Two is for students with three or more years in JAM. The general program's ages and free-class policy were not applied to camps because the camp page does not explicitly state camp ages or fees. Registration is by email to jamkidstc@gmail.com with the child's name and preferred contact information.
